Name: DE-Contracts
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Contract)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Contract)
with 
est as
(
    select  Contract,
            sum(ValueWithoutVatCost) as ValueWithoutTaxCost,
            sum(VatValueCost) as TaxValueCost,
            sum(ValueWithVatCost) as ValueWithTaxCost,
            sum(ValueWithoutVatIncome) as ValueWithoutTaxSell,
            sum(VatValueIncome) as TaxValueSell,
            sum(ValueWithVatIncome) as ValueWithTaxSell
    from    Estimate est, WorkflowState wfs, WorkflowStateType wst
    where   est.Contract is not null and
            wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
            wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType and
            wst.Name not in ('Draft', 'Canceled')
    group by Contract
)
select  cnt.Id as Oid,
        cnt.Id as DocumentOid,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        cnt.Name as Contract,
        cnt.Number as ContractNumber,
        cnt.StartDate as StartDate,
        cnt.EndDate,
        pjt.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        typ.Oid as TypeId,
        typ.Name as Type,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wst.Oid as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        own.Name as Owner,
        own.Id as OwnerId,
        own.HasImage as OwnerHasImage,
        isnull(est.ValueWithoutTaxCost, 0) as EstimatedWithoutTaxCost,
        isnull(est.TaxValueCost, 0) as EstimatedTaxCost,
        isnull(est.ValueWithTaxCost, 0) as EstimatedWithTaxCost,
        isnull(est.ValueWithoutTaxSell, 0) as EstimatedWithoutTaxSell,
        isnull(est.TaxValueSell, 0) as EstimatedTaxSell,
        isnull(est.ValueWithTaxSell, 0) as EstimatedWithTaxSell
from    ContractLookup cnt
            left join Contract pjt on pjt.Oid = cnt.Id
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = cnt.Client
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = cnt.Product
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = pro.Brand
            join JobType typ on typ.Oid = pjt.JobType
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = cnt.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            left join est on est.Contract = cnt.Id
            join UserLookup own on own.Id = cnt.Owner
where   wst.Status not in (1) and
        (@ModifiedFrom is null or pjt.ModifiedOnUtc >= @ModifiedFrom) and
        (@ContractId is null or cnt.Id = @ContractId) and
        (@ContractNumber is null or cnt.Number = cast(@ContractNumber as nvarchar))
